about: Schema fixture for profile_lines (FAM-040): a 70 x 20 mm architrave with a rounded nosing (one 3-point arc), drawn in the profile family's Ref. Level plan, x across and y up. No Keynote: a profile family's types may not carry the Keynote parameter, so it is left out until the Revit test confirms it. Run: fmc_doc open (template) -> apply (dry run, then real) -> save to _ChainTests.
